payload.title: Boundary: Papyrus newsroom stays editorial (no promote stage)
payload.description:
Parked boundary — do not implement. Not a type. Not in progress.

A published piece may seed a Campaign / Brief / Idea. Publicist cuts Deliverables, Posts, Slots, AdDrafts in Babulus.

No journalist media lists, pitches, or clip books.
